# expo-react-native-boilerplate

> A production-grade Expo + React Native boilerplate for cross-platform
> mobile (iOS, Android, Web) with multi-tenant SaaS conventions matching
> the sister project next-boilerplate. Routing via Expo Router v5;
> styling via NativeWind (Tailwind for RN); state via Zustand + MMKV;
> tokens in SecureStore; data fetching via a single axiosInstance.

This file follows the llms.txt convention so AI agents can quickly orient
without grepping the codebase. A full, machine-readable catalog of every
screen, component, service, store, DTO, and lib primitive is served from
`public/registry/`.

## Machine-readable catalog

- **Full registry (JSON):** `/registry/registry.json`
- **Lightweight index (JSON):** `/registry/registry.index.json`
- **Surface-by-surface:** `/registry/screens.json`, `/registry/components.json`, `/registry/services.json`, `/registry/stores.json`, `/registry/dtos.json`, `/registry/libs.json`
- **JSON Schema for validation:** `/schemas/registry-v1.json`
- **Per-component markdown chunks:** `/components/<category>-<name>.md`
- **Markdown chunk index:** `/components/_index.json`

Rebuild any time the codebase changes:

```bash
npm run registry:snapshot
```

The full registry includes for every:

- **Screen** (~22): `filePath`, `route`, `kind` (`screen` | `layout` | `not-found` | `html`), `group` (e.g. `auth`, `tabs`), `dynamic`, `layoutChain[]`.
- **Component** (~5): `id` (e.g. `ui/Button`), `filePath`, `name`, `category`, named `exports[]`, `props[]`.
- **Service** (~4 `*.service.client.ts`): `filePath`, `name`, exported `className`, static `methods[]`, axios `endpoints[]`.
- **Store** (~3): `filePath`, `name`, exported `hook` (e.g. `useAuthStore`), `stateKeys[]`, `persisted` flag.
- **DTO** (~5 in `dto/`): `filePath`, `name`, Zod `schemas[]` (ending in `Schema` / `Enum`), TS `types[]`.
- **Lib** (~7 in `libs/`): `filePath`, `name`, named `exports[]`.

## MCP server (Claude Desktop / Cursor / Cline / Windsurf / Zed)

Zero-dependency stdio MCP server. Config in `.mcp.json` at the repo root.
Tools:

- `list_screens` — filter by `kind` or `group`
- `get_screen` — by `filePath`, returns route, layout chain, group
- `search_screens` — substring search over filePath + route
- `list_components` — filter by `category`
- `get_component` — by id (e.g. `ui/Button`)
- `search_components` — substring search over id + name + props
- `list_services` — every `*.service.client.ts` with class + methods + endpoints
- `list_stores` — every Zustand store with hook + state keys + persisted flag
- `list_dtos` — every Zod DTO module with schemas + types
- `list_libs` — primitives (axios, env, i18n, logger, mmkv, secureStorage, zustandStorage)
- `get_conventions` — routing / styling / state / tokens / dataFetch / validation / icons / fileNaming
- `get_component_md` — pre-rendered per-component markdown chunk
- `read_file` — read any repo file (sandboxed to the repository root)

Reads from `public/registry/registry.json`. Refresh with `npm run registry:snapshot`.

## Editor-native rule files (mirror of AGENTS.md)

- `.cursor/rules/expo-react-native.mdc` — Cursor (modern)
- `.cursorrules` — Cursor (legacy)
- `.windsurfrules` — Windsurf
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md` — GitHub Copilot
- `.clinerules` — Cline / Continue.dev

## Architecture in one diagram

```
app/  (screens)  ──→  services/ + stores/  ──→  libs/axios + libs/secureStorage
              \                            /
               └──→  components/  ←──── utils/cn
                          ↑
                       dto/ (Zod, shared with server)
```

- **`app/`** — Expo Router file-based screens. `(group)` directories are
  route groups stripped from URLs. `_layout.tsx` defines layouts.
- **`components/<category>/`** — reusable UI under `auth/`, `ui/`, etc.
- **`services/*.service.client.ts`** — data fetchers using `axiosInstance`.
- **`stores/*Store.ts`** — Zustand, persisted via MMKV (`zustandStorage`).
- **`dto/*.dto.ts`** — Zod schemas + inferred types (server contracts).
- **`libs/*.ts`** — primitives (axios, env, i18n, logger, mmkv, secureStorage, zustandStorage).
- **`utils/cn.ts`** — `cn()` className helper.

## Conventions (must follow)

- **Routing:** Expo Router v5 file-based. Navigate with `router.push/replace` from `expo-router` or `<Link href="...">`.
- **Styling:** NativeWind (`className` + Tailwind tokens). Combine with `cn()` from `@/utils/cn`.
- **State:** Zustand + MMKV via `@/libs/zustandStorage`. **Never `AsyncStorage`**.
- **Tokens:** `expo-secure-store` ONLY (`@/libs/secureStorage`). Tokens NEVER live in Zustand or MMKV.
- **Data fetching:** `axiosInstance` from `@/libs/axios` ALWAYS. Never `fetch()`. Never ad-hoc axios.
- **Validation:** Zod everywhere. Parse every response with the matching DTO schema.
- **Env:** `@/libs/env` (Zod-validated). Never `process.env.*` in app code.
- **Logging:** `@/libs/logger`. Never `console.*`.
- **Icons:** FontAwesome 6 only (`@fortawesome/react-native-fontawesome`).
- **Haptics:** `expo-haptics` on auth + critical actions.
- **Toasts:** `sonner-native`.
- **Path alias:** only `@/* → ./*` is configured.

## Where to put new code

- New screen → `app/<route>.tsx` (or under an existing `(group)`)
- New layout → `app/**/.../_layout.tsx`
- New UI component → `components/<category>/<Pascal>.tsx`
- New data fetcher → `services/<name>.service.client.ts` + DTO in `dto/<name>.dto.ts`
- New persistent client state → `stores/<name>Store.ts` (use `zustandStorage`)
- New Zod schema → `dto/<name>.dto.ts`
- New primitive → `libs/<name>.ts`
- New translation → `locales/<lang>/<namespace>.json`
- Expo config (icons, splash, plugins) → `app.config.ts`
- Tests → `__tests__/<name>.test.ts(x)`

## How to use this catalog from an AI agent

1. Fetch `/registry/registry.index.json` for a fast scan of every screen + component + service + store + DTO + lib.
2. Filter `screens[]` by `group` or `kind` to find the right routing entry.
3. Look at `stores[].stateKeys` and `services[].methods` to discover what state and data fetching is already wired.
4. Fetch `/components/<category>-<name>.md` for the per-component import + props summary.
5. Use `services[].endpoints[]` to see which backend routes the app already talks to.
